description: This file defines the LocationCaptureManager class responsible for retrieving and processing device location data in an Android app.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager
classes.description: A manager class for capturing device location asynchronously, including permission checks, caching, and timeout handling.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Suspending function that retrieves the current device location, returning a Payload with location details.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent last known location from available providers that is within the specified maximum age.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests a fresh location update from the specified provider with a timeout.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Fetches device location, preferring cached data and requesting fresh data if needed, then formats it into a JSON string.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Selects the newest last known location from available providers, respecting the maximum age constraint.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests the current location from the specified provider within a given timeout.
